description: Defines the MerchantConfiguration entity class representing merchant configuration data, including mappings, attributes, and relationships for persistence.

classes.name: MerchantConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class for merchant configuration settings, mapping to MERCHANT_CONFIGURATION table with attributes like key, value, type, and relations to MerchantStore.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key identifier of the merchant configuration.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key identifier of the merchant configuration.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this configuration.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this configuration.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this configuration.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurationType
methods.description: Returns the type of merchant configuration.

methods.name: setMerchantConfigurationType
methods.description: Sets the type of merchant configuration.
